--- A `ViewModel` provides access to named properties used for data binding
--- between your application and a Rive file.
export type ViewModel = {

    --- The name of the view model.
    ---
    --- (Coming soon)
    name: string,

    --- Returns the numeric property with the given name, or nil if not found.
    ---
    --- ```lua
    --- local vmi = context:viewModel()
    --- if vmi then
    ---   local score = vmi:getNumber('score')
    ---   if score then
    ---     print(score.value)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    getNumber: (self: ViewModel, name:string) -> Property<number>?,

    --- Looks up a trigger property by name.
    --- Returns a `PropertyTrigger`.
    --- ```lua
    --- local vmi = context:viewModel()
    --- if vmi then
    ---   local myTrigger = vmi:getTrigger('myTrigger')
    ---   if myTrigger then
    ---     myTrigger:fire()
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    getTrigger: (self: ViewModel, name:string)-> PropertyTrigger?,

    --- Looks up a string property by name.
    --- Returns a `DataValueString`.
    --- ```lua
    --- local vmi = context:viewModel()
    --- if vmi then
    ---   local heading = vmi:getString('heading')
    ---   if heading then
    ---     print(heading.value)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    getString: (self: ViewModel, name:string) -> Property<string>?,

    --- Looks up a boolean property by name.
    --- Returns a `DataValueBoolean`.
    --- ```lua
    --- local vmi = context:viewModel()
    --- if vmi then
    ---   local darkMode = vmi:getBoolean('darkMode')
    ---   if darkMode then
    ---     print(darkMode.value)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    getBoolean: (self: ViewModel, name:string) -> Property<boolean>?,

    --- Looks up a color property by name.
    --- Returns a `DataValueColor`.
    --- ```lua
    --- local vmi = context:viewModel()
    --- if vmi then
    ---   local primaryColor = vmi:getColor('primaryColor')
    ---   if primaryColor then
    ---     primaryColor.value = Color.rgba(255, 0, 0, 155)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    getColor: (self: ViewModel, name:string) -> Property<Color>?,

    --- Looks up a List property by name.
    --- Returns a `PropertyList`.
    --- ```lua
    --- local vmi = context:viewModel()
    --- if vmi then
    ---   local enemies = vmi:getList('enemies')
    ---   if enemies then
    ---     enemies:pop()
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    getList: (self: ViewModel, name:string) -> PropertyList?,

    --- Looks up a view model property by name. Returns a `PropertyViewModel`.
    --- ```lua
    --- local vmi = context:viewModel()
    --- if vmi then
    ---     local nestedVM = vmi:getViewModel('MyVM')
    --- end
    --- ```
    getViewModel: (self: ViewModel, name:string) -> PropertyViewModel?,

    --- Looks up an enum by name.
    --- Returns a `PropertyEnum`.
    --- ```lua
    --- local vmi = context:viewModel()
    --- if vmi then
    ---     local textAlignment = vmi:getEnum('textAlignment')
    --- end
    --- ```
    getEnum: (self: ViewModel, name:string) -> PropertyEnum?,

    --- Creates a new instance of the ViewModel.
    --- Pass instanceName to specify an existing instance from the file to use as template
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: VMNameNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local vm = context:viewModel()
    ---   if vm then
    ---     local newInstance = vm:instance()
    ---     local age = newInstance:getNumber('age')
    ---     if age then
    ---       age.value = 99
    ---     end
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    instance: (self: ViewModel, instanceName: string?) -> ViewModel,

    --- Returns the index.
    --- Returns -1 if view model does not have an index available.
    getIndex: (self: ViewModel) -> number,

    --- Looks up an image by name.
    --- Returns a `Property<Image>`.
    --- ```lua
    --- local vmi = context:viewModel()
    --- if vmi then
    ---     local image1 = vmi:getImage('avatar')

    getImage: (self: ViewModel, name:string) -> Property<Image>?,

    --- Looks up a font by name.
    --- Returns a `Property<Font>`.

    --- if vm then
    ---     local fontProperty = vm:getFont('Inter')

    --- if vm then

--- Provides access to hierarchical data and its associated ViewModel.
export type DataContext = {

    --- Returns the parent DataContext, if one exists.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: MyNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local dc = context:dataContext()
    ---   if dc then
    ---      local parentDC = dc:parent()
    ---      local vm = dc:viewModel()
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    parent: (self: DataContext) -> DataContext?,

    --- Returns the ViewModel associated with this context.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: MyNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local dc = context:dataContext()
    ---   if dc then
    ---      local parentDC = dc:parent()
    ---      local vm = dc:viewModel()
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    viewModel: (self: DataContext) -> ViewModel?,
}

    ---     if textAlignment then
    ---         local values = textAlignment:values()

--- `PropertyList` is a mutable list of `ViewModel` items.
---
--- Use it to manage repeating data collections from scripts (for example, menu
--- items, inventory entries, or dynamic UI rows). A `PropertyList` supports:
--- - Reading item count via `length`
--- - 1-based indexed access (`list[1]`, `list[2]`, ...)
--- - Mutations (`push`, `insert`, `swap`, `pop`, `shift`, `clear`)
--- - Change notifications via `addListener` and `removeListener`
---
--- For a complete working example, see the [Scripting Lists](https://rive.app/community/files/27098-51051-scripting-lists/?utm_source=docs&utm_medium=scripting_api&utm_campaign=docs_to_marketplace_links) demo.
declare extern type PropertyList with

    --- The current number of items in the list.
    ---
    --- ```lua
    --- function handleSwap(self: MenuListController)
    ---   if self.menu and self.menu.length >= 2 then
    ---     self.menu:swap(1, 2)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    length: number

    --- Get the list item by index.
    --- ```lua
    --- function setItemLabel(menu: PropertyList, index: number, label: string)
    ---   if index >= 1 and index <= menu.length then
    ---     local item = menu[index] :: Data.Button
    ---     local itemLabel = item:getString('label')
    ---     if itemLabel then
    ---       itemLabel.value = label
    ---     end
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    [number]: ViewModel

    --- Adds a view model to the end of the list.
    --- ```lua
    --- function addButton(menu: PropertyList, label: string)
    ---   local buttonVm = Data.Button.new()
    ---
    ---     local buttonLabel = buttonVm:getString('label')
    ---     if buttonLabel then
    ---       buttonLabel.value = label
    ---     end
    ---
    ---     menu:push(buttonVm)
    --- end
    --- ```
    function push(self, vm: ViewModel): ()

    --- Inserts a view model at the given index.
    --- ```lua
    --- function insertAt(menu: PropertyList, label: string, index: number)
    ---   local buttonVm = Data.Button.new()
    ---
    ---   local buttonLabel = buttonVm:getString('label')
    ---   if buttonLabel then
    ---     buttonLabel.value = label
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   local insertIndex = math.max(1, math.min(index, menu.length + 1))
    ---   menu:insert(buttonVm, insertIndex)
    --- end
    --- ```
    function insert(self, vm: ViewModel, index: number): ()

    --- Swaps the positions of the view models at `index1` and `index2`.
    --- ```lua
    --- function swapItems(menu: PropertyList, index1: number, index2: number)
    ---   local highestIndex = math.max(index1, index2)
    ---
    ---   if menu and menu.length >= highestIndex then
    ---     menu:swap(index1, index2)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    function swap(self, index1: number, index2: number): ()

    --- Removes and returns the last view model in the list.
    --- ```lua
    --- function handlePop(self: MenuListController)
    ---   if self.menu then
    ---     self.menu:pop()
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    function pop(self): ViewModel?

    --- Removes and returns the first view model in the list.
    --- ```lua
    --- function handleShift(self: MenuListController)
    ---   if self.menu then
    ---     self.menu:shift()
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    function shift(self): ViewModel?

    --- Removes all view models from the list.
    --- ```lua
    --- function handleClearItems(self: MenuListController)
    ---   if self.menu then
    ---     self.menu:clear()
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    function clear(self): ()

    --- Removes a view model from the list.
    function remove(self, viewModel: ViewModel): ()

    --- Removes every list entry that references the given view model instance.
    function removeAllOf(self, viewModel: ViewModel): ()

    --- Removes the view model at the given 1-based index from the list.
    function removeAt(self, index: number): ()

    --- Adds a listener that is called when the list changes.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: MenuListController, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local vmi = context:rootViewModel() :: Data.Main
    ---   if vmi then
    ---     self.menu = vmi.menu
    ---     self.listChanged = listChanged
    ---
    ---     self.menu:addListener(self.listChanged)
    ---   else
    ---     print('[MenuListController] Warning: Could not find Main ViewModel.')
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    addListener: Listener<PropertyList>

    --- Removes a previously added list-change listener.
    --- ```lua
    --- function handleRemoveListener(self: MenuListController)
    ---   if self.menu and self.listChanged then
    ---     self.menu:removeListener(self.listChanged)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    removeListener: Listener<PropertyList>
end

--- Represents a property that holds a `ViewModel` value.
declare extern type PropertyViewModel with

    --- The current view model value.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: VMNameNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---     local vm = context:viewModel()
    ---     if vm then
    ---         local nestedVMProp = vm:getViewModel("nestedVM")
    ---         if nestedVMProp then
    ---             local nestedVM = nestedVMProp.value
    ---             local age = nestedVM:getNumber("age")
    ---             if age then
    ---                 print("nestedVM age:", age.value)
    ---             else
    ---                 print("'age' property not found on nestedVM.")
    ---             end
    ---         else
    ---             print("'nestedVM' property not found on ViewModel.")
    ---         end
    ---     else
    ---         print("No ViewModel found on context.")
    ---     end
    ---     return true
    --- end
    --- ```

    value: ViewModel
end

--- The file's view model factories, keyed by view model name.
--- `Data.MyViewModel.new()` creates a fresh instance of the view model named
--- `MyViewModel`; pass an instance name to copy an existing instance from the
--- file. Looking up a name with no matching view model returns nil.
--- ```lua
--- local button = Data.Button.new()
--- local label = button:getString('label')
--- if label then
---   label.value = 'Play'
--- end
--- ```
declare Data: { [string]: { new: (instanceName: string?) -> ViewModel } }

--- A blob asset containing raw binary data.
declare extern type Blob with

    --- The size of the blob data in bytes.
    --- ```lua
    --- type DrawBlob = {
    ---     myBlob: Blob?,
    --- }
    ---
    --- function init(self: DrawBlob, context: Context): boolean
    ---     self.myBlob = context:blob('myBlob')
    ---
    ---     if self.myBlob then
    ---         print('Blob size:', self.myBlob.size, 'bytes')
    ---     end
    ---
    ---     return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<DrawBlob>
    ---     return {
    ---         myBlob = nil,
    ---         init = init,
    ---     }
    --- end
    --- ```
    size: number

    --- The name of the blob asset.
    --- ```lua
    --- type DrawBlob = {
    ---     myBlob: Blob?,
    --- }
    ---
    --- function init(self: DrawBlob, context: Context): boolean
    ---     self.myBlob = context:blob('myBlob')
    ---
    ---     if self.myBlob then
    ---         print('Blob name:', self.myBlob.name)
    ---     end
    ---
    ---     return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<DrawBlob>
    ---     return {
    ---         myBlob = nil,
    ---         init = init,
    ---     }
    --- end
    --- ```
    name: string

    --- The raw binary data as a buffer. Read it with the `buffer` library,
    --- for example `buffer.readu8(blob.data, 0)`.
    --- ```lua
    --- type DrawBlob = {
    ---     myBlob: Blob?,
    --- }
    ---
    --- function init(self: DrawBlob, context: Context): boolean
    ---     self.myBlob = context:blob('myBlob')
    ---
    ---     if self.myBlob then
    ---         print('First byte:', buffer.readu8(self.myBlob.data, 0))
    ---     end
    ---
    ---     return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<DrawBlob>
    ---     return {
    ---         myBlob = nil,
    ---         init = init,
    ---     }
    --- end
    --- ```
    data: buffer
end

--- A playback instance returned by `Audio:play*`, with controls for transport and volume.
declare extern type AudioSound with

    --- stop the audio
    --- ```lua
    --- function stopSound(self: AudioScript)
    ---   if self.soundInstance then
    ---     self.soundInstance:stop()
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    function stop(self, fadeToStopTime: number?) : ()

    --- seek the audio to a specific time in seconds.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.soundInstance then
    ---   self.soundInstance:seek(self.seekSeconds)
    --- end
    --- ```
    function seek(self, seconds: number) : ()

    --- seek the audio to a specific time in PCM frames.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.soundInstance then
    ---   self.soundInstance:seekFrame(self.seekFrameNumber)
    --- end
    --- ```
    function seekFrame(self, frame: number) : ()

    --- Whether the sound has completed playing.
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: AudioScript, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   if self.soundInstance then
    ---     self.isCompleted = self.soundInstance:completed()      -- whether playback has finished
    ---   end
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    function completed(self) : boolean

    --- Current sound time in seconds.
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: AudioScript, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   if self.soundInstance then
    ---     self.currentTime = self.soundInstance:time()           -- current playback time in seconds
    ---   end
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    function time(self) : number

    --- Current sound time in PCM frames.
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: AudioScript, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   if self.soundInstance then
    ---     self.currentTimeFrame = self.soundInstance:timeFrame() -- current playback time in PCM frames
    ---   end
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    function timeFrame(self) : number

    --- volume of the sound.
    --- ```lua
    --- function update(self: AudioScript)
    ---   -- updates the volume for AudioSound playback when the input is changed
    ---   if self.soundInstance then
    ---     self.soundInstance.volume = self.volumeNumber / 100
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    volume: number

    --- pauses the audio.
    --- ```lua
    --- function pauseSound(self: AudioScript)
    ---   if self.soundInstance then
    ---     self.soundInstance:pause()
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    function pause(self) : ()

    --- resumes the audio from its current position.
    --- ```lua
    --- function resumeSound(self: AudioScript)
    ---   if self.soundInstance then
    ---     self.soundInstance:resume()
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    function resume(self) : ()

    --- plays the audio.
    --- ```lua
    --- function playSound(self: AudioScript)
    ---   if self.soundInstance then
    ---     self.soundInstance:play()
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    function play(self) : ()
end

declare Audio: {
    --- Returns the absolute time of the underlying audio engine in seconds.
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: AudioScript, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   -- Audio engine outputs: global clock independent of any sound instance
    ---   self.engineTime = Audio.time()           -- absolute engine time in seconds
    ---   self.engineTimeFrame = Audio.timeFrame() -- absolute engine time in PCM frames
    ---   self.sampleRate = Audio.sampleRate()     -- sample rate in Hz; use to convert: frames = seconds * sampleRate
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    time: @checked () -> number,

    --- Returns sample rate of the audio engine.
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: AudioScript, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   -- Audio engine outputs: global clock independent of any sound instance
    ---   self.engineTime = Audio.time()           -- absolute engine time in seconds
    ---   self.engineTimeFrame = Audio.timeFrame() -- absolute engine time in PCM frames
    ---   self.sampleRate = Audio.sampleRate()     -- sample rate in Hz; use to convert: frames = seconds * sampleRate
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    sampleRate: @checked () -> number,

    --- Returns the absolute time of the underlying audio engine in PCM frames.
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: AudioScript, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   -- Audio engine outputs: global clock independent of any sound instance
    ---   self.engineTime = Audio.time()           -- absolute engine time in seconds
    ---   self.engineTimeFrame = Audio.timeFrame() -- absolute engine time in PCM frames
    ---   self.sampleRate = Audio.sampleRate()     -- sample rate in Hz; use to convert: frames = seconds * sampleRate
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    timeFrame: @checked () -> number,

    --- Play the audio immediately.
    ---
    --- Returns `AudioSound`.
    --- ```lua
    --- function playSound(self: AudioScript)
    ---   if self.sourceAsset then
    ---     self.soundInstance = Audio.play(self.sourceAsset)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    play: @checked (AudioSource) -> AudioSound?,

    --- Play the sound at a specified absolute time in seconds. Use for better control of sounds initialization.
    ---
    --- Returns `AudioSound`.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Play at an absolute engine time in seconds using Audio.playAtTime()
    --- -- Set scheduleSeconds to Audio.time() + desired offset before firing
    --- function playAtTimeSound(self: AudioScript)
    ---   if self.sourceAsset then
    ---     self.soundInstance = Audio.playAtTime(self.sourceAsset, self.scheduleSeconds)
    ---     applyVolume(self)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    playAtTime: @checked (AudioSource, number) -> AudioSound?,

    --- Play the sound at a specified relative time in seconds. Relative to current Audio engine time.
    ---
    --- Returns `AudioSound`.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Play after a relative delay in seconds using Audio.playInTime()
    --- -- Set scheduleSeconds to the number of seconds to wait before playback starts
    --- function playInTimeSound(self: AudioScript)
    ---   if self.sourceAsset then
    ---     self.soundInstance = Audio.playInTime(self.sourceAsset, self.scheduleSeconds)
    ---     applyVolume(self)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    playInTime: @checked (AudioSource, number) -> AudioSound?,

    --- Play the sound at a specified absolute time in frames. Use for better control of sounds initialization.
    ---
    --- Returns `AudioSound`.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Play at an absolute engine frame using Audio.playAtFrame()
    --- -- Set scheduleFrames to Audio.timeFrame() + desired frame offset before firing
    --- function playAtFrameSound(self: AudioScript)
    ---   if self.sourceAsset then
    ---     self.soundInstance = Audio.playAtFrame(self.sourceAsset, self.scheduleFrames)
    ---     applyVolume(self)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    playAtFrame: @checked (AudioSource, number) -> AudioSound?,

    --- Play the sound at a specified relative time in frames. Relative to current Audio engine time.
    ---
    --- Returns `AudioSound`.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Play after a relative delay in PCM frames using Audio.playInFrame()
    --- -- Set scheduleFrames to the number of frames to wait before playback starts
    --- -- Tip: frames = seconds * Audio.sampleRate()
    --- function playInFrameSound(self: AudioScript)
    ---   if self.sourceAsset then
    ---     self.soundInstance = Audio.playInFrame(self.sourceAsset, self.scheduleFrames)
    ---     applyVolume(self)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    playInFrame: @checked (AudioSource, number) -> AudioSound?,
}

--- Raw decoded image pixels returned by context:decodeImage().
export type DecodedImage = {
    --- Premultiplied RGBA8 pixel data (width * height * 4 bytes).
    data: buffer,
    --- Width in pixels.
    width: number,
    --- Height in pixels.
    height: number,
}

--- Context is an object provided to scripted nodes during initialization (via the `init` function).
--- It serves as a bridge between your script and the Rive runtime, giving you access to:
--- - Update scheduling — Request that your node be updated on the next frame.
--- - Data (ViewModels) — Access the ViewModel data context bound to the node or the root artboard.
--- - Assets — Retrieve named assets (images, blobs, and audio) that have been added to the Rive file.
declare extern type Context with

    --- Logs a message through the host: the CLI watch log and problems
    --- surface, the editor console. Available on both script backends.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: MyNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---     context.log('hello')
    ---     return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    log: (message: string) -> ()

    --- Marks the object as needing an update on the next frame.
    --- Call this when something has changed (e.g., from a listener callback) and you need the runtime to re-invoke your node's update function.
    --- Note: Calls to `markNeedsUpdate` from inside `update()` are ignored. Use it from `init()`, `advance()`, listener callbacks, or event handlers instead.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: MyNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---     self.context = context
    ---     -- Access a ViewModel property and listen for changes
    ---     local vm = context:viewModel()
    ---     if vm then
    ---         local name = vm:getString("name")
    ---         if name then
    ---             name:addListener(function()
    ---                 -- Re-trigger update when the data changes
    ---                 if self.context then
    ---                     self.context:markNeedsUpdate()
    ---                 end
    ---             end)
    ---         end
    ---     end
    ---     return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    function markNeedsUpdate(self): ()

    --- Returns the `ViewModel` bound to the node's immediate data context. This is the most common way
    --- to read data-bound properties from a script.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: MyNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local vmi = context:viewModel()
    ---   if vmi then
    ---     local cannon = vmi:getTrigger('cannon')
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    function viewModel(self): ViewModel?

    --- Returns the `ViewModel` bound to the root artboard's data context.
    --- Useful when you need to access top-level data from a deeply nested node.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: MyNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local vmi = context:rootViewModel()
    ---   if vmi then
    ---     local cannon = vmi:getTrigger('cannon')
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    function rootViewModel(self): ViewModel?

    --- Returns the global `ViewModel` with the given name, or nil if there is no
    --- global view model by that name or none is currently bound.
    --- Global view models are shared, singleton-like view models addressed by name
    --- rather than through the node's own data context.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: MyNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local settings = context:globalViewModel('AppSettings')
    ---   if settings then
    ---     local volume = settings:getNumber('volume')
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    function globalViewModel(self, name: string): ViewModel?

    --- Returns a list of the names of all global view models defined in the file.
    --- Pass any of these names to `globalViewModel` to fetch the corresponding view model.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: MyNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---   for _, name in ipairs(context:globalViewModelNames()) do
    ---     print(name)
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    function globalViewModelNames(self): { string }

    --- Returns the data context provided to this node.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: MyNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local dc = context:dataContext()
    ---   if dc then
    ---      local parentDC = dc:parent()
    ---      local vm = dc:viewModel()
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    function dataContext(self): DataContext?

    --- Returns an image asset by name, or nil if not found.
    --- The returned `Image` can be drawn via `drawImage`.
    ---
    --- See also `ImageSampler`.
    ---
    --- Check out Scripting demos to see a working example.
    ---
    --- ```lua
    --- type DrawImage = {
    ---   myImage: Image?,
    ---   sampler: ImageSampler?,
    --- }
    ---
    --- function init(self: DrawImage, context: Context): boolean
    ---   self.myImage = context:image('myImage')
    ---   self.sampler = ImageSampler('clamp', 'clamp', 'bilinear')
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- function draw(self: DrawImage, renderer: Renderer)
    ---   if self.myImage and self.sampler then
    ---     renderer:drawImage(self.myImage, self.sampler, 'srcOver', 1)
    ---   end
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<DrawImage>
    ---   return {
    ---     myImage = nil,
    ---     sampler = nil,
    ---     init = init,
    ---     draw = draw,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    function image(self, name: string): Image?

    --- Returns a `Blob` (raw binary data) asset by name, or nil if not found.
    --- Useful for loading custom data files embedded in the Rive file.
    --- ```lua
    --- type DrawBlob = {
    ---     myBlob: Blob?,
    --- }
    ---
    --- function init(self: DrawBlob, context: Context): boolean
    ---     self.myBlob = context:blob('myBlob')
    ---
    ---     if self.myBlob then
    ---         print('Blob name:', self.myBlob.name)
    ---         print('Blob size:', self.myBlob.size, 'bytes')
    ---         print('First byte:', buffer.readu8(self.myBlob.data, 0))
    ---     end
    ---
    ---     return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<DrawBlob>
    ---     return {
    ---         myBlob = nil,
    ---         init = init,
    ---     }
    --- end
    --- ```
    function blob(self, name: string): Blob?

    --- Returns an `AudioSource` asset by name. The returned source can be played using the global `Audio` API.
    --- ```lua
    --- type AudioExample = {
    ---   play: Input<Trigger>,
    ---
    ---   source: AudioSource?,
    --- }
    ---
    --- function init(self: AudioExample, context: Context): boolean
    ---   self.source = context:audio("myAudio")
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- function playSound(self: AudioExample)
    ---   if self.source then
    ---     Audio.play(self.source)
    ---   end
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<AudioExample>
    ---   return {
    ---     play = playSound,
    ---     source = nil,
    ---     init = init,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    function audio(self, name: string): AudioSource?

    --- Create a 2D canvas for Rive Renderer drawing.
    --- Use beginFrame/endFrame during draw to render.
    ---
    --- The descriptor is optional. Omitting it (or passing width/height of
    --- 0) creates a deferred canvas with no backing texture — useful in
    --- layout scripts that don't know their size at init. Call
    --- `canvas:resize(w, h)` once the real size is known. While deferred,
    --- `canvas.image` is nil and `width`/`height` report 0; calling
    --- `beginFrame()` raises an error pointing to `resize()`. Check
    --- `canvas.width > 0` to gate work.
    function canvas(self, desc: {
        width: number,
        height: number,
        clearColor: Color?,
    }?): Canvas

    --- Create a GPU canvas — a 1× presentation target. Render to it via
    --- `canvas:beginRenderPass(...)`. For MSAA, allocate the multisampled
    --- color and depth textures yourself with `GPUTexture.new({
    --- sampleCount = N, renderTarget = true })` and pass them in the
    --- descriptor.
    ---
    --- The descriptor is optional. Omitting it (or passing width/height of
    --- 0) creates a deferred canvas with no backing texture — useful in
    --- layout scripts that don't know their size at init. Call
    --- `canvas:resize(w, h)` once the real size is known. While deferred,
    --- `width`/`height` report 0 and calling `colorView()` raises an error
    --- pointing to `resize()`. Check `canvas.width > 0` to gate work.
    function gpuCanvas(self, desc: {
        width: number,
        height: number,
    }?): GPUCanvas

    --- Query GPU capabilities. Returns a table of supported features
    --- and limits for the current backend.
    function features(self): GPUFeatures

    --- Get a compiled shader by asset name (the name as added in the editor,
    --- with no ".wgsl" extension). Returns a Shader ready for use in
    --- GPUPipeline.new(), or nil if the named shader is not found.
    function shader(self, name: string): Shader?

    --- Decode compressed image data (PNG, JPEG, WebP) into premultiplied RGBA8 pixels.
    --- Returns a Promise that resolves with a DecodedImage table.
    --- Use with await() inside async(), or chain with :andThen().
    function decodeImage(self, data: buffer): Promise<DecodedImage>

end

--- Node scripts can be used to render shapes, images, text, artboards, and more.
--- A scripted node can be attached to any Node and is rendered
--- in the local transform space of the hosting Node.
---
--- For more information, see Node Scripts.
export type Node<T> = {

    --- Called once when the node is created. Returns true if initialization
    --- succeeds.
    ---
    --- For a more complete example using `init`, see Instantiating Components.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Define the script's data and inputs.
    --- type MyNode = {}
    ---
    --- -- Called once when the script initializes.
    --- function init(self: MyNode, context: Context): boolean
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- -- Return a factory function that Rive uses to build the Node instance.
    --- return function(): Node<MyNode>
    ---   return {
    ---     init = init
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    init: ((self: T, context: Context) -> boolean)?,

    --- Optional per-frame update. Returns true if the node should continue
    --- receiving advance calls.
    ---
    --- For a more complete example using `advance`, see Fixed-step Advanced.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Define the script's data and inputs.
    --- type MyNode = {}
    ---
    --- -- Called every frame to advance the simulation.
    --- -- 'seconds' is the elapsed time since the previous frame.
    --- function advance(self: MyNode, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   return false
    --- end
    ---
    --- -- Return a factory function that Rive uses to build the Node instance.
    --- return function(): Node<MyNode>
    ---   return {
    ---     advance = advance,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    advance: ((self: T, seconds: number) -> boolean)?,

    --- Called when an input value changes.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Define the script's data and inputs.
    --- type MyNode = {}
    ---
    --- -- Called when any input value changes.
    --- function update(self: MyNode)
    ---   print('An script input value has changed.')
    --- end
    ---
    --- -- Return a factory function that Rive uses to build the Node instance.
    --- return function(): Node<MyNode>
    ---   return {
    ---     update = update,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    update: (self: T) -> ()?,

    --- Called to render the node using the provided `Renderer`.
    ---
    --- For a more complete example using draw, see Instantiating Components.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Define the script's data and inputs.
    --- type MyNode = {}
    ---
    --- -- Called every frame (after advance) to render the content.
    --- function draw(self: MyNode, renderer: Renderer) end
    ---
    --- -- Return a factory function that Rive uses to build the Node instance.
    --- return function(): Node<MyNode>
    ---   return {
    ---     draw = draw,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    --- GPU canvas work (canvas:beginFrame, gpuCanvas:beginRenderPass) also
    --- happens here, in any order; replay schedules canvas dependencies. The
    --- former drawCanvas callback was removed: move its body into draw.
    draw: ((self: T, renderer: Renderer) -> ())?,

    --- Pointer event down handler.
    ---
    --- ```lua
    --- function handlePointerDown(self: MyGame, event: PointerEvent)
    ---   print('Pointer Position: ', event.position.x, event.position.y)
    ---
    ---   event:hit()
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<MyGame>
    ---     return {
    ---         init = init,
    ---         advance = advance,
    ---         draw = draw,
    ---         pointerDown = handlePointerDown,
    ---     }
    --- end
    --- ```
    pointerDown: (self: T, event:PointerEvent) -> ()?,

    --- Pointer event move handler.
    ---
    --- ```lua
    --- function handlePointerMove(self: MyGame, event: PointerEvent)
    ---   print('Pointer Position: ', event.position.x, event.position.y)
    ---
    ---   event:hit()
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<MyGame>
    ---     return {
    ---         init = init,
    ---         advance = advance,
    ---         draw = draw,
    ---         pointerMove = handlePointerMove,
    ---     }
    --- end
    --- ```
    pointerMove: (self: T, event:PointerEvent) -> ()?,

    --- Pointer event up handler.
    --- ```lua
    --- function handlePointerUp(self: MyGame, event: PointerEvent)
    ---   print('Pointer Position: ', event.position.x, event.position.y)
    ---
    ---   event:hit()
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<MyGame>
    ---     return {
    ---         init = init,
    ---         advance = advance,
    ---         draw = draw,
    ---         pointerUp = handlePointerUp,
    ---     }
    --- end
    --- ```
    pointerUp: (self: T, event:PointerEvent) -> ()?,

    --- Pointer event exit handler.
    --- ```lua
    --- function handlePointerExit(self: MyGame, event: PointerEvent)
    ---   print('Pointer Position: ', event.position.x, event.position.y)
    ---
    ---   event:hit()
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<MyGame>
    ---     return {
    ---         init = init,
    ---         advance = advance,
    ---         draw = draw,
    ---         pointerExit = handlePointerExit,
    ---     }
    --- end
    --- ```
    pointerExit: (self: T, event:PointerEvent) -> ()?,

    gamepadConnected: (self: T, event:GamepadConnected) -> ()?,
    gamepadEvent: (self: T, event:GamepadEvent) -> ()?,
    gamepadDisconnected: (self: T, event:GamepadDisconnected) -> ()?,
} & T

--- A scripted converter used for transforming values between ViewModel data
--- bindings and Rive properties.
---
--- Type parameters:
---   T: The converter type
---   I: The input type, must be a DataValue type
---      (DataValueNumber, DataValueString, DataValueBoolean, DataValueColor, etc)
---   O: The output type, must be a DataValue type
---      (DataValueNumber, DataValueString, DataValueBoolean, DataValueColor, etc)
---
--- For more information, see Converter Scripts.
export type Converter<T, I, O> = {

    --- Called once when the converter is created. Returns true if initialization
    --- succeeds.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Called once when the script initializes.
    --- function init(self: MyConverter, context: Context): boolean
    ---
    ---     -- Return false to stop the script.
    ---     return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    init: ((self: T, context: Context) -> boolean)?,

    --- Converts the input value (a view model property) to an output value.
    --- The input parameter must be a DataValue type.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Converts the value when binding from source to target.
    --- function convert(self: MyConverter, input: DataInputs): DataOutput
    ---
    ---   local dv: DataValueNumber = DataValue.number()
    ---   if input:isNumber() then
    ---     -- Example: Add 1 to the incoming number
    ---     dv.value = (input :: DataValueNumber).value + 1
    ---   end
    ---   return dv
    --- end
    --- ```
    convert: (self: T, input: I) -> O,

    --- Converts the output value back to an input value (a view model property).
    --- The input parameter must be a DataValue type.
    --- ```lua
    --- function reverseConvert(
    ---   self: MyConverter,
    ---   input: DataOutput
    --- ): DataInputs
    ---   local dv: DataValueNumber = DataValue.number()
    ---   if input:isNumber() then
    ---     -- Example: Subract 1 from the target number
    ---     dv.value = (input :: DataValueNumber).value - 1
    ---   end
    ---   return dv
    --- end
    --- ```
    reverseConvert: (self: T, input: O) -> I,

    --- Optional per-frame update. Returns true if the converter should continue
    --- receiving advance calls.
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: MyConverter, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   return false
    --- end
    --- ```
    advance: ((self: T, seconds: number) -> boolean)?,
} & T

--- A scripted Layout which can function just like a `Node` but
--- also has the ability to fit into a layout box provided via
--- resize. It can also be intrinsically sized allowing hosting
--- layouts to attempt to fit to its size by using the measure
--- function to report desired dimensions.
---
--- For more information, see Layout Scripts.
export type Layout<T> = Node<T> & {

    --- When provided this Layout can be intrinsically sized/request
    --- to be a specific size. This is not guaranteed as the layout
    --- may have min/max dimensions. Resize will be called with the
    --- granted size after being measured.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Measure the computed size of the layout on resize
    --- function measure(self: MyLayout): Vector
    ---   return Vector.xy(100, 100)
    --- end
    --- ```
    measure: ((self: T) -> Vector) | nil,

    --- When provided, called to set the initial size and again whenever
    --- the size changes. Layouts that do not react to their box may omit
    --- it; the runtime no-ops when it is not implemented.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Called when the layout resizes based on the content
    --- -- This only applies to Layouts with a fit type of Hug
    --- -- scale is the presenting surface's device pixels per point.
    --- function resize(self: MyLayout, size: Vector, scale: number)
    ---   print('Resize:', size, scale)
    --- end
    --- ```
    resize: ((self: T, size: Vector, scale: number) -> ()) | nil,
} & T

--- Represents a typed input value.
--- ```lua
--- -- Define the script's data and inputs.
--- type MyNode = {
---   speed: Input<number>,
---   title: Input<string>,
---   enabled: Input<boolean>,
---   onReset: Input<Trigger>,
--- }
---
--- -- Return a factory function that Rive uses to build the Node instance.
--- return function(): Node<MyNode>
---   return {
---     speed = 1,
---     title = 'Rive so coooool!',
---     enabled = false,
---     onReset = function() end,
---   }
--- end
--- ```
export type Input<T> = T

--- Represents a typed output value.
---
--- (Coming soon)
export type Output<T> = T

--- A function that triggers an action when invoked.
--- ```lua
--- -- Define the script's data and inputs.
--- type MyNode = {
---   onReset: Input<Trigger>,
--- }
---
--- -- Return a factory function that Rive uses to build the Node instance.
--- return function(): Node<MyNode>
---   return {
---     onReset = function() end,
---   }
--- end
--- ```
export type Trigger = (any)->()

--- A scripted effect applied to a path
--- For effects that can change over time, even
--- when the path does not change, markNeedsAdvance()
--- should be called on its context in the advance function
---
--- For more information, see Path Effect Scripts.
export type PathEffect<T> = {

    --- Called once when the effect is created or attached.
    --- Return `true` to keep the effect active, or `false` to disable it.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- Called once when the script initializes.
    --- function init(self: MyPathEffect, context: Context): boolean
    ---
    ---     -- Return false to stop the script.
    ---     return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    init: ((self: T, context: Context) -> boolean)?,

    --- Called any time an input changes.
    --- You receive the original `PathData` and must return the path
    --- that should be used for rendering.
    --- ```lua
    --- function update(self: MyPathEffect, inPath: PathData): PathData
    ---     local path = Path.new()
    ---     return path
    --- end
    --- ```
    update: (self: T, path: PathData, node: NodeReadData) -> PathData,

    --- Called every frame to advance the effect over time.
    --- `seconds` is the time delta since the last frame.
    --- Return `true` to keep the effect active, or `false` to disable it.
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: MyPathEffect, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   return false
    --- end
    --- ```
    advance: ((self: T, seconds: number) -> boolean)?,
} & T

--- An action performed when an associated State Machine Listener is triggered.
---
--- For more information, see Listener Action Scripts.
export type ListenerAction<T> = {

    --- Called once when the listener is created or attached.
    --- ```lua
    --- type MyListenerAction = {}
    ---
    --- -- Called once when the script initializes.
    --- function init(self: MyListenerAction, context: Context): boolean
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- function perform(self: MyListenerAction, pointerEvent: PointerEvent) end
    ---
    --- return function(): ListenerAction<MyListenerAction>
    ---   return {
    ---     init = init,
    ---     perform = perform,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    init: ((self: T, context: Context) -> boolean)?,

    --- Called when the associated State Machine Listener is triggered.
    --- This method includes a `PointerEvent` parameter containing details about the triggering interaction.
    ---
    --- **Deprecated.** Prefer `performAction` with `ListenerContext`; this overload may be removed.
    --- ```lua
    --- type MyListenerAction = {}
    ---
    --- function init(self: MyListenerAction, context: Context): boolean
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- -- Add your transition logic here.
    --- function perform(self: MyListenerAction, pointerEvent: PointerEvent)
    ---   -- perform action here
    --- end
    ---
    --- -- Return a factory function that Rive uses to build the Listener Action instance.
    --- return function(): ListenerAction<MyListenerAction>
    ---   return {
    ---     init = init,
    ---     perform = perform,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    perform: ((self: T, pointerEvent: PointerEvent) -> ())?,

    --- Called when the associated State Machine Listener is triggered.
    --- This method includes a `ListenerContext` parameter containing details about the triggering interaction.
    --- ```lua
    --- type MyListenerAction = {}
    ---
    --- function init(self: MyListenerAction, context: Context): boolean
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- -- Called each time the listener fires.
    --- function performAction(self: MyListenerAction, listenerContext: ListenerContext)
    ---   if listenerContext:isPointerEvent() then
    ---     print('clicked')
    ---   end
    --- end
    ---
    --- -- Return a factory function that Rive uses to build the Listener Action instance.
    --- return function(): ListenerAction<MyListenerAction>
    ---   return {
    ---     init = init,
    ---     performAction = performAction,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    performAction: ((self: T, listenerContext: ListenerContext) -> ())?,

} & T

--- A condition to evaluate for a transition between state machine states to be taken.
---
--- For more information, see Transition Condition Scripts.
export type TransitionCondition<T> = {

    --- Called once when the transition condition is created or attached.
    --- ```lua
    --- type MyTransitionCondition = {}
    ---
    --- -- Called once when the script initializes.
    --- function init(self: MyTransitionCondition, context: Context): boolean
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- function evaluate(self: MyTransitionCondition): boolean
    ---   return false
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): TransitionCondition<MyTransitionCondition>
    ---   return {
    ---     init = init,
    ---     evaluate = evaluate,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    init: ((self: T, context: Context) -> boolean)?,

    --- Called every frame while the transition is active.
    --- ```lua
    --- type MyTransitionCondition = {}
    ---
    --- function init(self: MyTransitionCondition, context: Context): boolean
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- -- Add your transition logic here.
    --- -- `evaluate` is fired every frame while the transition is active.
    --- -- Returning false prevents a transition, true allows a transition.
    --- function evaluate(self: MyTransitionCondition): boolean
    ---   return false
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): TransitionCondition<MyTransitionCondition>
    ---   return {
    ---     init = init,
    ---     evaluate = evaluate,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    evaluate: (self: T) -> boolean,

} & T
--- An interpolator
---
export type Interpolator<T> = {

    init: ((self: T, context: Context) -> boolean)?,

    transform: (self: T, value: number) -> number,
    transformValue: (self: T, from: number, to: number, value: number) -> number,

} & T

--- A handle to one child (a nested artboard) of a Transition, valid only for
--- the duration of the `draw` (and `changed`) call it is passed to. Draw it
--- with `child:draw(renderer)`, wrapping the call in renderer state
--- (save / modulateOpacity / transform / clipPath / restore) to author the
--- transition effect.
export type TransitionChild = {
    --- Draw this child's content at the renderer's current transform.
    draw: (self: TransitionChild, renderer: Renderer) -> (),
    --- The child artboard's natural width, useful for slide/scale math.
    width: number,
    --- The child artboard's natural height.
    height: number,
}

--- Renders the visual change between an outgoing ("from") and incoming ("to")
--- child when a Transition's active child changes. The active child is chosen
--- natively (and is data-bindable, Solo-style); the script owns only how the
--- two children are composited. Declare any inputs you need (e.g. a director
--- Artboard, numbers, curves) as ordinary script inputs and drive the effect
--- however you like.
---
--- For more information, see Transition Scripts.
export type Transition<T> = {

    --- Called once when the transition is created.
    init: ((self: T, context: Context) -> boolean)?,

    --- Called when the active child changes. `from` is the outgoing child
    --- (nil on the first show); `to` is the incoming child. `direction` is 1
    --- when `to` is at a higher combined index than `from`, -1 when lower, and
    --- 0 when unknown (e.g. the first show). Reset your progress clock / seek
    --- any input you drive here. Called again on interruption, where `from` is
    --- the previously-incoming child.
    changed: ((self: T, from: TransitionChild?, to: TransitionChild?, direction: number) -> ())?,

    --- Called every frame while a transition is in flight. Advance your own
    --- progress (and any input you drive). Return true while running; return
    --- false to signal completion, after which the runtime retires the
    --- outgoing child and resumes drawing the active child normally.
    advance: (self: T, seconds: number) -> boolean,

    --- When false, the incoming ("to") child renders normally through the
    --- artboard draw loop and is passed as nil to draw; the script composites
    --- only the outgoing ("from") child (useful for "reveal" transitions where
    --- the new content is already on-stage). Defaults to true (the script
    --- composites both children). Read at the start of each transition, so it
    --- may be set in init or changed.
    managesTo: boolean?,

    --- Composite the two children. Wrap each `child:draw(renderer)` in renderer
    --- state (save / modulateOpacity / transform / clipPath / restore) to
    --- author crossfade, slide, wipe, scale, and custom effects. Either child
    --- may be nil (see `managesTo`).
    draw: (self: T, renderer: Renderer, from: TransitionChild?, to: TransitionChild?) -> (),

} & T
```
